title: Clipped: a leopard walking through a tiger reserve

scenes.headline: This leopard lives in a tiger reserve

scenes.label: Prey up to 10 times its own weight
scenes.body: It often carries the carcass to a nearby tree to eat.

scenes.headline: Filmed in Rajaji Tiger Reserve, Uttarakhand

caption:
Tigers get the headlines. Leopards share the forest.

Leopards are solitary, mostly nocturnal hunters that often carry a carcass to a secluded spot, typically a nearby tree, to eat.

Source: Animal Diversity Web.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
